title: Catholic Coordinator of Religious Education (CRE)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.USMC.MARCORP I&L.MARINE CORPS INSTALLATIONS COMMAND.MCIPAC.COMMANDING OFFICER
description_text: The MCIPAC Regional Contracting Office is soliciting M67400-26-Q0008 for Catholic Coordinator of Religious Education services aboard MCAS Iwakuni in accordance with Performance Work Statement (PWS). When submitting quotes, please complete the attached solicitation document, and provide a technical plan/description that addresses all tasks listed in accordance with the Performance Work Statement. Responsible Offerors must be active in the System Award Management (SAM) in accordance with DFARS 252.204-7004 unless you qualify under an exemption. Unique Entity ID (UEI), TIN and CAGE Code must be written on submitted proposal. If you are an interested vendor, please send all completed documents to the following email address: sakuta.hiroshi.ja@usmc.mil and daniel.nachlas@usmc.mil. Note: Questions and Answers related to this solicitation have been posted. Please refer to the attached Q&A document for details.
